title: This Spider Lives Underwater in a Bubble It Built Itself

scenes.text: This spider lives underwater inside a bubble it built itself.
It's the diving bell spider. It carries air down from the surface, trapped in the hairs on its body.
It releases the air into a silk dome tied to a plant.
Then the bubble becomes a gill. Oxygen seeps in from the water, and carbon dioxide seeps out.
One bubble can keep it alive for over a day.
It eats, mates and raises its young down there. A spider that lives underwater.

description:
This spider lives underwater inside a bubble it built itself.
The diving bell spider traps air in a silk dome, and the bubble works like a gill that pulls in oxygen from the water, so one bubble can last over a day.
Would you live in a bubble underwater?
first_comment: Scientists found its bubble acts as a gill, so it never needs a tank. What would you build your underwater home out of?
